PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.

2. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Immediate Environment.

5. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.

6. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.

7. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.

8. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

9. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.

10. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Metallic Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Non- Metallic Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
